topics.headline: Oil spike post-ceasefire collapse threatens July CPI/HICP reacceleration
topics.summary: June's US CPI (3.5%) and Eurozone HICP (2.8%) both cooled on falling energy prices, but the Iran ceasefire's collapse has since sent Brent crude toward $90, and economists warn July's readings (due Aug 12 and Jul 31/Aug 19) could reverse higher rather than extend the downtrend.

topics.headline: HY spreads near cycle lows, absorbing rate rise without widening
topics.summary: HY OAS sits near 2.7%, close to its 18-month low, and held firm even as Treasury yields backed up and CCC-vs-B dispersion widened; most desks and strategists see modest upside risk to spreads but no imminent widening, with quality bifurcation (isolated defaults, hyperscaler IG stress) the main watch item.

topics.headline: BTC ETFs post third straight inflow day, but momentum remains fragile
topics.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs logged $79.15M in inflows on July 16, a third consecutive positive session following an eight-week, $8.2B outflow streak that only just broke in early July. Flows have whipsawed between sharp inflows and outflows week to week, and with Fear & Greed still at 28, the trend leans modestly positive but is too shaky to call durable.

topics.headline: VIX jumps 12% to 18.77 amid Iran conflict, but curve stays calm
Dedicated power deals keep landing despite NY moratorium headlines
topics.summary: Chevron-Microsoft's 2.67GW Texas gas deal, BlackRock/ACS's Coravel data-center launch, and an ECL-PowerCell 300MW+ hydrogen tie-up all closed within weeks, confirming hyperscalers are still striking new build/PPA agreements monthly even as New York's moratorium and community pushback (xAI Memphis) create political friction.
